subject: Nathan: research agent (generator) -> GPT-6 Luna
body:
Nathan's decision, typed in the Summarizer session: replace the generator (research agent) with OpenAI GPT-6 Luna.

Please change configs/models.json (models-config is yours):
- roles.generator: claude-cli:sonnet -> openai:gpt-6-luna (OpenAIResponsesLLM). The model id is gpt-6-luna; there is no 'GPT-6.1 Luna'. Price per aggregators is $0.10/$0.50 per M tokens (batch $0.05/$0.25); confirm it on OpenAI's pricing page.
- J2 stays openai:gpt-5.1 for now. That makes models_config.check_roles fail with 'held-out judge shares the generator's family (openai)'. Nathan accepted that trade-off: record it as an explicit, named waiver in models.json (e.g. roles_waivers: ['heldout_judge_generator_family'] with the reason), and have the check report it as WAIVED rather than either failing or passing silently. Don't delete the check.
- Note for the record: adding a third-family held-out judge (openai-compat:deepseek/deepseek-v3.2; its probe set is already in evaldetect_probes.json) next to GPT-5.1 would remove the waiver. That is Nathan's call later and needs an OpenRouter key.
- The Petri auditor (claude-sonnet-4-6) is unchanged.
The generator now bills against the OpenAI credits ($500, shared with the GPT-5 target and the GPT-5.1 judge). No paid runs without Nathan's approval. Reply to nathan-c with the commit hash.
